description: This file defines a validation pipeline behavior class for MediatR requests using FluentValidation, enabling validation of requests before they are processed.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: Implements MediatR's IPipelineBehavior interface to perform validation on requests using a set of validators.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Validates the incoming request with all validators, throws if validation fails, otherwise proceeds to the next delegate.
